breadcrumb: Std 8 Science (English) — Unit 10: Changes around us — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: A chemical change is a permanent and irreversible change which produces a new substance. Changes like burning of paper, digestion of food, turning of milk into curd and decaying of vegetables are chemical changes.

en.q: Which of the following is a physical change?
en.explanation: Folding paper, drying wet clothes and bending an iron rod are physical changes.

ta.explanation: காகிதத்தை மடித்தல், ஈர ஆடை உலர்தல், இரும்புக் கம்பி வளைதல் ஆகியவை இயற்பியல் மாற்றங்கள்.

questions.quote: Qutub Minar in Delhi has a rust resistant iron-pillar. It has not rusted for more than 1500 years.

en.q: The iron pillar at Qutub Minar, Delhi has not rusted for more than ______ years.
en.explanation: It is a rust resistant iron pillar.

ta.q: டெல்லி குதுப்மினாரிலுள்ள இரும்புத் தூண் ______ ஆண்டுகளுக்கு மேலாகத் துருப்பிடிக்கவில்லை.

questions.quote: Chemical reactions accompanying evolution of heat are called exothermic reactions. Whereas chemical reactions which involve absorption of heat are called endothermic reactions.

en.q: Chemical reactions which involve absorption of heat are called ______.

ta.explanation: வெப்பத்தை வெளியிடும் வினைகள் வெப்பம் உமிழ் வினைகள்.

questions.quote: The term electrolysis was introduced by Michael Faraday in the 19th century. The word electrolysis is a combination of two terms 'electron' and 'lysis'.
Electrolysis of water containing small amounts of sulphuric acid liberates hydrogen and oxygen gases.

en.q: When electricity is passed through water containing a small amount of sulphuric acid, ______ gases are liberated.

ta.q: சிறிதளவு சல்பியூரிக் அமிலம் கலந்த நீரில் மின்சாரத்தைச் செலுத்தும்போது ______ வாயுக்கள் வெளியாகின்றன.

questions.quote: Some chemical reactions can be achieved by the supply of heat only. These reactions are called thermo chemical reactions or thermolysis. In industries limestone rocks are heated to get quicklime (calcium oxide).

en.q: Reactions that proceed only by the supply of heat are called ______.
en.explanation: Heating lead nitrate and limestone are examples. (Decomposition by heat is thermolysis.)

ta.q: வெப்பத்தை அளிப்பதால் மட்டுமே நிகழும் வினைகள் ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: Photosynthesis is a process in which light energy from the sun is used by the plants to prepare starch from carbon dioxide and water. Chemical reactions induced by light are called photochemical reactions. The ultraviolet rays break ozone molecules in the stratosphere.

en.q: Chemical reactions induced by light are called ______.
en.explanation: Photochemistry deals with chemical reactions involving light.

ta.explanation: ஒளி தொடர்பான வேதிவினைகளைப் பற்றிப் படிப்பது ஒளிவேதியியல்.

questions.quote: Enzymes and yeasts are called biocatalysts. In vanaspati ghee (dalda) preparation, finely divided nickel is used as a catalyst.

en.q: Which of the following are called biocatalysts?
en.explanation: Metallic iron (Haber) and nickel (vanaspati) are non-biological catalysts.

ta.q: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் உயிர் வினைவேக மாற்றிகள் எனப்படுபவை எவை?
ta.explanation: இரும்பு (ஹேபர்), நிக்கல் (வனஸ்பதி) உயிரியல் அல்லாத வினைவேக மாற்றிகள்.

questions.quote: Apples and some fruits turn brown due to chemical reaction with oxygen in air. This chemical reaction is called browning. The cells contain an enzyme called polyphenol oxidase or tyrosinase.

en.q: The chemical reaction that turns a cut apple brown is called ______.
en.explanation: It occurs due to reaction with oxygen in air.

ta.q: வெட்டிய ஆப்பிள் பழுப்பாவதற்குக் காரணமான வேதிவினை ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: Rusting: when iron metal comes into contact with water and oxygen, it undergoes a chemical reaction called rusting.

en.q: Table 10.1 lists oxides of sulphur and nitrogen, carbon monoxide, chlorofluorocarbons and methane as pollutants of ______.
en.explanation: Water pollutants include waste water from dyeing industries, detergents and oil spillage; land pollutants include fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides and plastics.

ta.q: கந்தக, நைட்ரஜன் ஆக்சைடுகள், கார்பன் மோனாக்சைடு, CFC, மீத்தேன் ஆகியவை ______ மாசுபடுத்திகள்.
ta.explanation: நீர் மாசுபடுத்திகள்: சாயத் தொழிற்சாலைக் கழிவு, சலவைத்தூள், எண்ணெய்க் கசிவு; நில மாசுபடுத்திகள்: உரங்கள், பூச்சிக்கொல்லிகள், நெகிழி.

questions.quote: Rusting is a chemical reaction in which iron objects form hydrated ferric oxide in the presence of oxygen and water. Global warming is a dangerous condition in which earth's average temperature rises alarmingly due to various human activities.

en.explanation: Rusting needs both oxygen and water.

questions.quote: Photolysis is a process in which light is used to carry out chemical reactions. Thermolysis is a process in which heat is used to bring about chemical reactions.

en.q: The process in which light is used to carry out chemical reactions is called ______.
en.explanation: Thermolysis uses heat; electrolysis uses electricity.

ta.q: ஒளியைப் பயன்படுத்தி வேதிவினைகளை நிகழ்த்தும் செயல்முறை ______ எனப்படும்.
